name: Fleeting Figment
body:
School illusion (figment); Level bard 0, magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a bit of fleece)

EFFECT

Range short (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect visual figment that cannot extend beyond one 5-ft. cube
Duration concentration, up to 5 rounds
Saving Throw Will disbelief (if interacted with); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as silent image, except as described above.
